day_local: NgoMgqibelo weVeki yamashumi amathathu anesine ngexesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni loYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, siqulekelele. Kristu, siqulekelele. Nkosi, siqulekelele.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntwana encinane ekhangela iinkwenkwezi. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayenalo olo hlobo lomdla—ingqondo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyokufunda izibalo okanye ukubhala ikhowudi ye-GitHub, yayiyingqondo eyayifuna ukwazi imfihlelo yendalo yonke. Wayethanda iinqwelo-moya, wayephupha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, kwaye xa wayethetha ngazo, ubuso bakhe babukhazimla ngoncumo olumsulwa. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, uYohane usibonisa umbono onamandla: 'Umlambo wamanzi obomi, ukhazimla njengekristale, uqukuqela uphuma etroneni kaThixo.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Umlambo wamanzi obomi. Lo mlambo awupheli, awumisi, kwaye awunalo ubumnyama. UBen ngoku usela kulo mlambo, apho akusekho zintlungu, akusekho zifo, kwaye akusekho mda.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha amazwi asixwayisayo kodwa asikhuthazayo: 'Qaphelani ukuba iintliziyo zenu zingasindi… nibe liliso ngamaxesha onke.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Nibe liliso. Oku akuthethi ukuba kufuneka siphile ngokoyika. Kuthetha ukuba kufuneka siphile ngokulindela. UYesu uyazi ukuba ubomi bunokuba nzima. Uyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho intliziyo isinda ngenxa yosizi. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo, ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, intliziyo yenu ikhumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen wayesemncumile, ehleka, kwaye esenza amaphupha akhe abe yinyani. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho nibuzayo ukuba kutheni, kwaye kutheni ngoku. Kodwa namhlanje, ndifuna ukususa elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu. UBen akazange agule ngenxa yokuba kukho into eniyenzileyo okanye eningayenzanga. Akukho nto niyiphosileyo. Iziphithiphithi zeli hlabathi, izifo, kunye neentlungu, zizinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye uBen akakubeki icala. UBen wayenothando olungagungqiyo kuni, kwaye uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lukhanya.

UYesu uthi: 'Nithandaze ukuba nibe namandla okubaleka ezi zinto zizayo, nime phambi koNyana woMntu.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Ukuma phambi koNyana woMntu. UBen umi phambi koThixo ngoku. Umi apho ukukhanya kungapheliyo. Umi apho iinqwelo-moya zakhe zibhabha phezulu, apho akukho mda wemida yeli hlabathi. Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Khumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen, eseneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, wathetha nabazali bakhe etsheho ukuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayesandula ukuhlaselwa zizifo ezimbini. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kwaye yayingafuneki ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-insurance, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

Alan noThao, nina bafazi namadoda abathandayo uBen, nina Ryan, mfowethu kaBen, hlalani neli themba. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci. Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ulapha, kwaye ndizimanya nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akukhanyisele ngoxolo lwakhe olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umntwana wethu uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abakhathazekileyo nabasentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abaphe ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: U-Yohane wathi: Ingelosi yandibonisa umlambo wamanzi obomi, ukhazimla njengekristale, uqukuqela uphuma etroneni kaThixo neyeMvana phakathi kwesitrato. Kwicala ngalinye lomlambo kwakukhula umthi wobomi ovelisa iziqhamo amaxesha alishumi elinesibini ngonyaka, kanye ngenyanga nganye; amagqabi emithi asebenza njengeyeza leentlanga. Akusayi kubakho nto iqalekisiweyo. Itrone kaThixo neyeMvana iya kuba kuwo, kwaye abakhonzi bakhe baya kumkhonza. Baya kubona ubuso bakhe, kwaye igama lakhe liya kuba semabunzini abo. Ubusuku abusayi kubakho, kwaye abasayi kufuna kukhanya kwesibane okanye kwelanga, kuba iNkosi uThixo iya kubanika ukukhanya, kwaye baya kulawula ngonaphakade kanaphakade. Yathi kum, 'La mazwi athembekile yaye ayinyani, kwaye iNkosi, uThixo wemimoya yesiprofeto, yathumela ingelosi yayo ukuba ibonise abakhonzi bayo oko kufuneka kwenzeke kungekudala.' 'Yabonani, ndiza kamsinya.' Unoyolo lowo ugcina umyalezo wesiprofeto wale ncwadi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: 'Qaphelani ukuba iintliziyo zenu zingasindi ngenxa yokuzitika nokunxila kwanangenxa yeengxaki zobomi bemihla ngemihla, kwaye loo mini inganibambi ngesiquphe njengomgibe. Kuba loo mini iya kuhlasela wonke umntu ohlala ebusweni bomhlaba. Nibe liliso ngamaxesha onke kwaye nithandaze ukuba nibe namandla okubaleka iimbandezelo ezizayo, nime phambi koNyana woMntu.'

day: Saturday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Sad
pet_prayers.text: Miss you kid! We are in Taiwan right now. Thinking of you everywhere we go. Mom cries almost every day over here

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
